reason: Adds Grok video billing metadata to usage_logs and relaxes the image-size check so video rows billed through token-mode channels are accepted.
risk: The migration adds NOT NULL/defaulted usage_logs columns and drops/recreates the image-size CHECK constraint, which can briefly lock usage_logs during deployment.
mitigation: The new columns are additive with defaults for older code, the replacement constraint remains restrictive for image billing, and it only exempts rows explicitly marked as video usage.
